meta.title: NEUZ — Bespoke art & design in Marrakech
meta.description: A creative house in Marrakech. Bespoke sculpted rugs, mirrors and wall artworks, bringing contemporary art and Moroccan craftsmanship into dialogue.

hero.text: Bespoke rugs, mirrors and wall art, imagined in Marrakech for your space. Where art, design and material meet.
hero.caption: Spatial study · Wall art

maison.label: 01 — The house
maison.title: An artistic sensibility.
maison.text: NEUZ is a Moroccan house of artistic and decorative creation, born in Marrakech. We imagine works that converse with the architecture, light and identity of each place.
maison.text2: Between contemporary art, design and artisanal savoir-faire, each creation is conceived as a presence. A material, a line, an emotion that stays with you.
maison.caption: Art in conversation with space
maison.quote: We do not simply seek to decorate a place. We seek to give it a visual emotion.

creations.label: 02 — The creations
creations.title: Living materials.
creations.intro: Rugs, mirrors, wall artworks… Free expressions, brought together by a shared signature.
creations.note: A selection of creations and artistic visualisations. Each project is adapted to your space.
creations.more: And beyond: artistic tables, sculptures, paintings, poufs and cushions.
creations.bespoke: Something else in mind? Let’s talk.
creations.customText: Dimensions, palette and finishes are defined together, according to your space and your vision.

arch.name: The inhabited arch
arch.description: A composition of arches in earth and sand tones. Textile relief follows the volumes of the room, creating a quiet focal point.
arch.alt: Textile wall art with sculptural arches in a cream-toned interior

wave.name: Free contours
wave.description: An undulating silhouette, outlined in deep blue and ochre. A mirror conceived as an artwork in its own right, between reflection and material.
wave.alt: Organic wavy mirror in navy blue, cream and ochre in a warm interior

rug.name: Fragments of earth
rug.description: Abstract shapes meet in a palette of earth, cream and blue. A textile composition where texture traces movement.
rug.alt: Abstract cream, orange and blue rug displayed on a working frame

mirror.name: An architectural echo
mirror.description: The arch becomes a tactile object. A textured frame, natural tones and a presence that responds to the lines of the architecture.
mirror.alt: Arched textile-framed mirror in a minimalist Moroccan living room

color.name: Material in motion
color.description: An exploration of volume and colour. Pinks, earth tones and contrasts compose an expressive textile landscape, imagined for a floor or a wall.
color.alt: Abstract sculptural rug with pink, orange and earthy colours

babouche.name: A memory of shapes
babouche.description: A familiar form from Moroccan craftsmanship, reinterpreted in a contemporary silhouette. Deep blue outlines a gentle reflection.
babouche.alt: Pointed babouche-inspired mirror with a navy blue textile border

savoir.label: 03 — The craft
savoir.title: Shaped by hand.
savoir.text: Draw a line. Choose a fibre. Shape a relief. Our approach brings the artisan’s gesture into conversation with a contemporary vision of the object.
savoir.text2: Sculpted textures, interplay of volumes, unexpected colours: material is never an afterthought. It is where everything begins.
savoir.detailAlt: Close-up of sculpted textile fibres in a pink and orange rug
savoir.workshopAlt: Tufting frame, yarn and tools in the workshop
savoir.caption: From the first thread to the final touch

process.label: 04 — Bespoke
process.title: Your idea.
process.intro: The right creation begins with a conversation. We accompany you from the first inspiration to the finished piece.

steps.title: The conversation
steps.text: Your space, your wishes, your constraints. We take the time to understand what makes your project distinct.

steps.title: Artistic direction
steps.text: An intention, a palette, a set of references. Together, we establish the creative world of your piece.

steps.title: The design
steps.text: Sketches, shapes, materials and dimensions: the idea becomes clearer and the creation takes form.

steps.title: Visualisation
steps.text: When the project calls for it, a 3D visualisation helps you imagine the work within your space.

steps.title: The approval
steps.text: We confirm the details, finishes, budget and production arrangements together.

steps.title: The making
steps.text: The piece comes to life, with attention to its volumes, textures and every finishing touch.

professionals.label: 05 — Collaborations
professionals.title: You imagine the space.
professionals.text: Architects, interior designers, hotels, riads, restaurants and brands: let’s imagine pieces that extend your vision, from a singular gesture to a cohesive whole.
professionals.caption: Visualisation · Art meets hospitality
professionals.alt: Warm Moroccan lounge with a composition of arches on the wall

contact.label: 06 — Your project
contact.title: What if it all began
contact.text: A photo, a plan, a 3D render or simply an inspiration. Share your starting point, and let’s imagine what comes next.
contact.faqTitle: A few answers before we begin

faq.a: We imagine rugs, mirrors, wall artworks, paintings, sculptures, artistic tables, poufs and cushions. Each project is designed in dialogue with your space.

faq.q: Can a piece be adapted for a professional project?
faq.a: Yes. We collaborate with architects, interior designers, hotels, riads, restaurants and companies to develop creations suited to their project.

faq.q: How can I request a bespoke quote?
faq.a: Share your project type, the creations you have in mind, dimensions if you know them and an indicative budget. You can attach references. We will follow up by WhatsApp, email or phone, according to your preference.

privacy.title: Your information, handled with care.
privacy.text: Your form details are sent to NEUZ to review your enquiry and contact you using your preferred method. Resend handles email delivery and the enquiry arrives in NEUZ’s Gmail mailbox. Your references are not published on the website. Please do not upload confidential documents or sensitive personal information.
privacy.rights: For questions or to request deletion of your information, email {email}. This site does not use advertising cookies. A preference cookie may remember your language choice.

services.privacyDescription: How NEUZ uses your enquiry details and how to contact us about your personal information.
services.planningText: Share a photograph or plan of your space, the dimensions you have in mind, your preferred colours and an indicative budget. If you are still exploring, tell us what you know: the brief can take shape through discussion. The quote defines the details and conditions of the project before production.

rugs.title: Bespoke rugs in Marrakech
rugs.description: Explore NEUZ’s bespoke rug designs in Marrakech: sculptural textiles, colour compositions and a creative process shaped around your interior.
rugs.intro: NEUZ is a creative house in Marrakech designing bespoke rugs as part of an artistic interior. The rug becomes a composition of colour, texture and relief, developed in conversation with your space.
rugs.detail: Our textile studies explore abstract shapes, contrasting colours and sculpted volumes. A reference can begin with the room itself, a palette or a visual idea. Dimensions, fibres, colours and finishes are discussed during design and confirmed for each project.
rugs.question: What should I consider for a bespoke rug?
rugs.answer: Tell us where the rug will sit, the available floor area and how the room is used. Bring photographs and any material or colour preferences. These details help define the proportions and textile direction; the final specifications are agreed as part of the quote.

mirrors.title: Bespoke mirrors in Marrakech
mirrors.description: Discover NEUZ’s bespoke mirror designs in Marrakech, from arches and waves to babouche-inspired forms, imagined around your space.
mirrors.intro: NEUZ imagines bespoke mirrors in Marrakech as decorative pieces that bring shape and reflection into a room. Our studies explore arches, flowing lines and forms inspired by Moroccan visual culture.
mirrors.detail: The mirror can be the starting point for an interior composition or a response to existing architecture. The wave, arch and babouche studies offer different ways to frame a reflection. Their proportions, colours and surrounding materials are considered in relation to the project.
mirrors.question: What information helps define a bespoke mirror?
mirrors.answer: Share the wall dimensions, a photograph of the setting and the shape or atmosphere you prefer. Mention nearby furniture and lighting. Dimensions, finish and installation requirements should be discussed and confirmed for your particular space.

wall.title: Bespoke wall art in Marrakech
wall.description: Explore bespoke wall art by NEUZ in Marrakech: textile relief, architectural compositions and artistic studies for homes and hospitality spaces.
wall.intro: NEUZ creates artistic concepts for bespoke wall pieces in Marrakech. The work is imagined in relation to architecture, light and the character of a space, with textile relief and sculptural composition as points of exploration.
wall.detail: Our arch study brings earth and sand tones into a wall composition. It shows how relief can respond to the volumes of a room and create a focal point. These visual studies are references for discussion; each project is developed for its own setting.
wall.question: How do I prepare a wall art brief?
wall.answer: Share the wall measurements, photographs or plans, and the effect you want the piece to create. Tell us whether the project is residential, a hotel, a riad, a restaurant or another professional space. Materials, dimensions and installation conditions are defined for the individual project.
